task_definition.task_description: Please check what coupons are available for me, save a short note that the coupon lookup was done, then look up popular alternatives to the black Sony WH-1000XM5 in electronics and choose one recommendation to buy. After that, place 1 unit of the selected recommendation on hold and confirm that order, then get the current BTC price and the USD-to-EUR exchange rate, check out the best recommendation for 2 units of the original product under accessories, get the current UTC time, and finally send Alex a high-priority app alert that the shopping workflow is complete and includes the market reference data.

user_input.query: For user_123, please check what coupons are available for me, then save a short note that the coupon lookup was done. After that, in electronics, look up popular alternatives to the black Sony WH-1000XM5 for product_id p_sony_xm5_blk and choose one recommendation to buy using paypal. Place quantity 1 of the selected recommendation on hold and confirm that order. Then get the current BTC price and the USD-to-EUR exchange rate for target_currency EUR. Also, in accessories, check out the best recommendation for secondary_quantity 2 units of the original product, secondary_product_id p_sony_xm5_blk. Get the current time in timezone UTC, and finally send Alex a high-priority app alert saying the shopping workflow is complete and include the market reference data.
